```yaml
name: Rebuild Model Site on Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  rebuild:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Trigger Vercel Deploy Hook
        env:
          MODEL_SITE_DEPLOY_HOOK: ${{ secrets.MODEL_SITE_DEPLOY_HOOK }}
        run: |
          echo "Triggering Vercel deploy hook..."
          curl -f -X POST "$MODEL_SITE_DEPLOY_HOOK"
```
